activity_summary: Edith came with the account already written, promised before Twelfth Night, and Heminges was not in the room. She fastened the back of Sam's coat, which he could not reach, and she let out Nick's seam at the chest without a speech. Humphrey found two stale rolls by their marks and burned them. Augustine counted the songs that are still current. You answered the entrance at once, from the left, and you made no new question.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the entrance, ordered the burning, and stopped.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Wrote nothing new, mended the hook, and let out the seam without remark.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Counted the current songs and kept the mornings.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named the tight chest once, then left it, and stayed under the note.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Admitted the hook, and took the left entrance.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Named copies by their marks, and burned two.

facets.activity: Answered at once, and let two rolls burn

quotes.speaker: edith_kettlewood
quotes.text: Master Heminges has said it will be paid before Twelfth Night.

quotes.speaker: edith_kettlewood
quotes.text: It is let out. A seam, at the chest.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will answer it now, and I will not make you a new one.
